title: All the Facts, Still the Wrong Answer: Integration Gaps in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.33764v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal reasoning requires models to combine multiple pieces of evidence into decisions that satisfy all relevant constraints. Evaluations centered on final-answer accuracy leave unclear whether failures arise from reading individual facts or using them together. We study this question through the multi-evidence integration gap, linking local fact recovery to global decision validity on controlled subset-selection and path-finding tasks. Our evaluation combines conditional performance given correct local answers with same-grid local queries, text-oracle inputs, retrieval controls, and constraint ablations. We further examine hidden-state probes and activation replacement across network depth, token positions, and model families. Across the evaluated models, accurate local recovery coexists with substantial global failure. translated_title: 掌握所有事实，却仍给出错误答案：视觉-语言模型中的整合差距
translated_abstract: 多模态推理要求模型将多条证据结合，做出满足所有相关约束的决策。以最终答案准确率为核心的评估方式，无法明确失败究竟源于读取单个事实，还是源于将它们结合使用。我们通过“多证据整合差距”来研究这一问题，在受控的子集选择和路径查找任务上，将局部事实恢复与全局决策有效性联系起来。我们的评估结合了在局部答案正确条件下的性能表现、同一网格上的局部查询、文本神谕输入、检索控制以及约束消融实验。我们进一步在模型深度、token位置和不同模型家族上考察了隐藏状态探测与激活替换方法。在所有被评估的模型中，准确的局部事实恢复与严重的全局决策失败并存。例如，Gemma-3-27B能正确恢复所有被评估的孤立条目事实，但全局有效性仅达到19.75%（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 视觉-语言模型虽能准确读取单个事实，却在将多条证据整合为满足所有约束的全局决策时存在严重缺陷，揭示了“多证据整合差距”这一核心问题。
en_tdlr: Vision-language models can accurately recover individual facts but fail substantially when integrating multiple pieces of evidence into globally valid decisions, revealing a fundamental "multi-evidence integration gap."
